stem: Root-zone EC rises over several measurements while containers are also drying farther between irrigation events. What should the technician do?
choices: Treat the EC trend as unrelated to water removal
Document both trends together and escalate them with the irrigation/root-zone context
Delete the moisture data so the EC trend is simpler
rationale: Water loss can concentrate dissolved ions. Root-zone EC and dryback should be interpreted together rather than as unrelated measurements.
